note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 7999 Section 3.3 ('The receiving party agreed to honor the BLACKHOLE community on the particular BGP session.' paired with the prefix-coverage condition of the same MUST sentence). Verified blackholeRouteType (rib_blackhole.go) returns 0 unless len(cfg.communities) > 0, coveredByAuthorized holds, and entryCarriesBlackhole matches. Positives assert exact routetype.Blackhole on both rails when agreed and covered (TestRFC7999BlackholeHonoredForTheEqualAuthorizedPrefix, TestBlackholeRouteTypeStampedOnBestPath, TestBlackholeRuleForDynamicGroup, TestBlackholeGroupIdentityArrivesOnAStructuredEvent) and kernel discard in checkRFC7999Blackhole. Negatives isolate absent agreement with covering authorization present (TestBlackholeNotStampedWhenNoCommunityAgreedButAuthorizationExists), a session outside the agreed dynamic group (TestBlackholeRuleForDynamicGroup#2), uncovered/shorter prefixes (TestRFC7999BlackholeNotHonoredOutsideTheAuthorizedPrefix), and BIRD announcing 65535:666 on a session agreed only for 65001:666 asserting kernel forwarding (checkRFC7999Blackhole). Q1-Q4 pass.
